_doc: Pueblo: tools/kerb_blocks.py's 75 candidate runs (kerb_blocks_2023_030.candidates.json), each checked by eye on tools/edge_sheet.py zooms of NAIP 2023 at 0.3 m (candidates_2023_030_sheet_00..07.jpg, cells c<i> in candidate order, long ones in pieces c<i>.<j>; the magenta mark 3 m outside the named edge, ticks every 10 m). kerb true = red / white blocks along that edge over the span. Spans are the finder's, so the true extents run past some (the notes). Ledger 0081 round 2.
